approval_required_for: No approval is required for the bounded read-only observability and exact-harness provenance repair described above.

Obtain bounded human approval if current exact-board discovery yields multiple plausible wrapper/simulation-source/Vivado-export contexts, no authorized VCS executable, or no evidence-backed way to select the exact sample-project integration; do not guess names, paths, commands, or targets.

Architecture, pipeline, memory-layout, numeric-policy/tolerance, checkpoint/stimulus/reference, model scope, exact board-wrapper source, or DUT RTL changes are outside this repair authorization and require separate approval.

consumes: current user-supplied sample-project wrapper and simulation-source hashes
current board identity document, tool profile, and exact Vivado export facts
current immutable checkpoint tensor catalog, target-model reference manifest, stimulus provenance, expected-output manifest, and frozen numeric comparison policy
current Transformer-block tensor-to-loader-to-DUT binding manifest and live case_multilayer_pipeline evidence

active contamination barriers contamination_barrier.0329 through contamination_barrier.0352 and open retry requests retry_request.0136, retry_request.0140, retry_request.0141, retry_request.0142, retry_request.0143, and retry_request.0144
executable_actions.on_failure: If current source identity, wrapper/source hash, Vivado export, authorized executable, complete Transformer-block loader binding, independent target reference, fixed numeric policy, or generated testbench binding cannot be established, keep VCS and all downstream board gates blocked. Repair only the harness/provenance contract; do not infer an RTL defect, generate expected outputs from RTL/random data, relax tolerance, substitute a simplified wrapper, or clear SACG blockers. If exact discovery yields multiple plausible source/export contexts or none, request bounded approval with the cited alternatives rather than guessing.
produces: verification/board_simulation/board_tb.sv generated against the exact discovered board wrapper and simulation sources
hash-bound board_simulation_manifest containing exact wrapper/source hashes, generated-testbench hash, immutable semantic artifact hashes, and direct-probe signal mapping
updated simulation identity document and canonical VCS compile-plan authority binding whose commands and executables cite the current Vivado export and authorized tool profile
board-scope semantic loader/weight-consumption binding report covering every required Transformer-block tensor and excluding model-tail scope
read-only direct certified-kernel boundary probe manifest with cycle-correlated valid/ready/accepted counts and lifecycle observations
SACG candidate-lineage update that records the new artifacts while retaining existing barriers and retries until a passing Stage7 candidate is promoted
executable_actions.rationale: Repair the smallest current-layer capability gap before hardware localization. Derive all wrapper, simulation-source, Vivado-export, command, and executable facts from the current user-supplied sample project; materialize the missing board testbench only as a generated, hash-bound semantic harness around that exact wrapper. Bind immutable semantic artifacts and add read-only direct certified-kernel ingress/egress/lifecycle monitors so a later replay can localize the frontier stall without modifying the DUT or lower layers.

consumes: passing case_axi_ddr_interface report for the current identity and canonical VCS plan
immutable checkpoint, stimulus, target-model expected outputs, fixed numeric comparison policy, and complete Transformer-block DUT-consumption proof
live operator-leaf and connected-kernel promotion certificates as reusable comparison context
executable_actions.on_failure: If the replay again fails before or during simulation, retain the failure as current-layer tool evidence and repair the earliest violated harness, wrapper, loader, protocol, or integration boundary only. If the direct trace shows wrapper ingress but no certified-kernel ingress/lifecycle, repair the current board integration slice. If it shows kernel egress asserted but wrapper egress unaccepted, repair the current wrapper/egress slice. Reopen the connected kernel or an operator leaf only if this current hash-bound trace includes direct core start, ingress, egress, a named causal boundary, and an explicit contradiction of the matching lower-layer certificate; otherwise preserve lower-layer certification. Do not promote on a trace alone.
produces: verification/vcs/case_board_vcs_functional.json with current compile and simulation evidence
verification/board_simulation/rtl_output.memh and current numeric-comparison results when simulation reaches the comparison boundary

verification/debug_closure/boundary_trace.json containing wrapper and direct certified-kernel input/output valid-ready-handshake counts, acceptance counts, lifecycle values, and adaptive stall snapshots

targeted replay/failure-localization record stating whether evidence localizes wrapper ingress, kernel launch/lifecycle, kernel egress, wrapper egress, AXI/DDR integration, or an explicitly evidenced lower-layer contradiction
executable_actions.rationale: Once the exact-board static capability is accepted, execute the current board layer using the immutable target-model semantic contract and collect the required direct kernel boundary trace. This is the first authorized hardware-facing localization step and preserves the hierarchy by diagnosing wrapper/integration boundaries before considering any lower-layer challenge.

consumes: current VCS replay, normalized boundary trace, and diagnosis from repair.current_board_vcs_direct_boundary_replay
current exact-board identity/compile-plan authority and board simulation manifest
immutable checkpoint, target-model expected outputs, stimulus provenance, frozen numeric policy, and complete Transformer-block loader/DUT-consumption evidence
current active SACG barriers and open retry requests
executable_actions.on_failure: Fail closed at board_axi_ddr_wrapped_system, use the newly produced current trace/diagnosis to localize the earliest causal boundary, and schedule only the corresponding bounded current-layer repair followed by this same gate DAG. Missing checker/reference capability remains a verification repair, while actual protocol, order, liveness, value, or DDR evidence localizes a current wrapper/integration repair. Do not alter checkpoint, stimulus, expected outputs, tolerance, testbench contract, or exact wrapper hashes; do not proceed to backend or board runtime; and do not reopen lower layers absent the required explicit contradiction.
produces: fresh current board gate reports for multilayer functional behavior, pipeline deadlock/liveness, AXI protocol, and DDR image roundtrip
verification/semantic_evidence/board_axi_ddr.json assembled only from current hash-bound target-reference, DUT-consumption, VCS, and board-gate evidence
current Stage7 board_axi_ddr_closure candidate evidence package with gate statuses and source hashes
SACG update that retains rejected-artifact barriers and open retries unless the Stage7 candidate passes all required gates and subsequent reconciliation explicitly promotes it
executable_actions.rationale: A repaired board harness and localized VCS replay are not a board pass. Execute the remaining required current-layer functional, liveness, AXI protocol, DDR image, semantic-evidence, and required-real-tool checks against the same immutable semantic contract, then record a candidate result without consuming historical rejected artifacts as validated evidence.

observations: real_tool.case_axi_ddr_interface failed because the current simulation identity hash, Vivado-export compile authority, ordered-command authority references, and executable authorization do not bind the current exact-board identity. This is a runtime-harness/verification-capability failure and does not establish a hardware defect.

functional_sim is a dependency-unsatisfied aggregate, with board_tb.sv absent from the required board-simulation artifacts. VCS functional simulation, VCS evidence analysis, AXI/deadlock diagnostics, protocol checks, DDR roundtrip, and board semantic evidence are not current executed functional evidence.

The prior report of wrapper ingress completion with zero accepted wrapper-output beats is planning-only because the associated diagnosis is historical-only and source identity changed. It motivates, but cannot replace, a current hash-bound direct certified-kernel boundary trace.

The bounded missing capability is read-only observability at the direct certified-kernel ingress and egress plus kernel lifecycle state. The probe must distinguish no ingress, accepted-but-no-launch/no-egress, blocked egress, and completed-but-unpropagated output without changing DUT behavior, stimulus, expected outputs, numeric policy, or wrapper functionality.

Live hash-validated lower-layer evidence remains reusable: operator leaves are certified and the connected kernel is certified as an elastic variable-latency token pipeline with preserved boundary order and required cross-token overlap. A board output frontier stall alone is not a contradiction of either certificate.

No active scoped backtrack request exists. Therefore neither operator leaves nor the connected kernel may be reopened unless a current direct-boundary trace, matching the named certificate context, explicitly contradicts a named lower-layer invariant.

sacg_memory_truth authoritatively reports 15 active same-scope contamination barriers and 6 open same-scope retry requests. Rejected Stage7/Stage8 artifacts remain usable only as planning and debugging evidence; they cannot be treated as validated inputs or silently cleared by this repair decision.

Before any board functional-pass claim, the repaired harness must retain immutable checkpoint and stimulus provenance, independent target-model expected outputs, fixed resolved comparison policy, generated testbench hashes, and complete-scope proof that the DUT consumed every required Transformer-block tensor. Embedding/tokenization and model-tail functions remain outside the DUT and its golden/weight requirements.
The conditional design-team router made no specialist split. That does not alter the real-tool evidence requirement or authorize a hardware pass.
proposed_actions: Repair only the exact-board simulation capability: rediscover the current sample-project sources and Vivado facts, regenerate the missing board testbench as a hash-bound semantic harness, authorize the compile plan, and add a read-only direct certified-kernel boundary probe.
Rerun the failed current-layer static/interface gate before invoking VCS. If the identity/authority gate remains failed, continue harness/provenance repair rather than diagnosing RTL.

After static acceptance, run the real VCS replay and analyze a cycle-correlated direct kernel ingress/egress/lifecycle trace. Use the earliest observed current-layer causal boundary for any subsequent bounded repair.

Only after the VCS replay is valid, execute the remaining board functional, liveness, AXI protocol, DDR roundtrip, semantic-evidence, and required-real-tool checks. Preserve active SACG barriers and retries pending a passing Stage7 candidate and formal reconciliation.

Do not reopen lower layers, alter numeric policy, change checkpoint/stimulus/reference outputs, modify golden outputs, or advance to backend synthesis, bitstream, runtime ABI, or board runtime in this loop.
risks: Source and tool provenance risk: using a guessed executable, stale identity hash, simplified wrapper, or compile command not cited by the current Vivado export would invalidate board evidence even if simulation compiles.
Semantic risk: a missing or partial loader binding, checkpoint catalog, target-model reference, expected-output provenance, or fixed tolerance would make any apparent RTL match non-authoritative.

Integration risk: wrapper ingress, AXI/prefetch activity, and lifecycle/output-frontier progress are distinct. A zero output frontier localizes the next observation but does not name an RTL root cause.

Protocol and data-order risk: after the VCS replay is enabled, AXI handshakes, DDR address/image roundtrip, transfer counts, token ordering, output acceptance, and numeric comparison remain unverified until their respective board gates execute.
Lower-layer regression risk: modifying certified leaf or elastic connected-kernel RTL without a direct trace contradiction would discard valid certification and violate the hierarchical repair loop.

Trust-contamination risk: the active barriers and open retry requests block downstream consumption and promotion until a fresh content-addressed board candidate passes the current Stage7 gate set and is reconciled through SACG.
Scope risk: extending the board DUT or golden to embedding, tokenization, final norm, LM head/logits, or sampling would violate the Transformer-block-only accelerator boundary.

constraints: exact user-supplied board-wrapper and simulation-source identity requirement
active SACG contamination barriers and open retry requests are downstream-consumption blockers
edges: exact board source identity and Vivado export facts -> authorized canonical VCS compile plan -> case_axi_ddr_interface

immutable checkpoint, target-model reference, deterministic-or-real stimulus provenance, fixed numeric policy, and complete Transformer-block tensor binding -> board semantic testbench -> functional_sim
direct certified-kernel ingress/egress and lifecycle trace -> current-layer failure localization -> bounded wrapper/loader/harness repair or conditional lower-layer backtrack
all board-layer gate passes with hash-bound evidence -> Stage7 candidate reconciliation; unresolved gates or active trust barriers -> no backend or board-runtime promotion
nodes: current user-supplied sample-project wrapper and simulation sources
current Vivado export facts and authorized VCS compile plan
board semantic testbench and loader contract

output.summary: Fail closed at the board_axi_ddr_wrapped_system layer. The authoritative executed failure is a verification-capability and exact-board-integration binding failure, not an RTL, AXI, DDR, numeric, or connected-kernel failure. First rebuild and hash-bind the exact board simulation harness, compile authority, semantic inputs, and read-only direct kernel-boundary probe; then rerun the current board layer. No lower-layer reopening or backend/board promotion is authorized.
